article.title: The Israeli elections have become a fight over October 7, but only Zionist opinions are allowed
article.author: Jonathan Ofir
article.content: Israeli election season has been dominated by Zionist debate over October 7, but this debate has not included discussion of ending the Gaza genocide because no one in Israeli society wants this to happen.
